title: Project consistency
intro: Compare database references with project directories. Inspection changes nothing and does not read document contents. External connections are outside this inspection. Each correction is explicit, without deletion or overwriting.
administrator: This page is restricted to administrators.
failed: The inspection could not be completed. Consistency cannot be confirmed.
changed: The inspection changed and has been refreshed. Review it before confirming another correction.
repairFailed: The correction could not be applied. Review the refreshed inspection before retrying.
healthy: No inconsistency detected within the inspected scope.
manual: Check the origin of this item and the available backup. No safe automatic correction is offered.
confirmDirectory: Only this empty directory will be created, without overwriting an existing item. No document or Git repository will be reconstructed. The situation will be checked again before the correction.
confirmReference: Only this reference will be updated to the existing directory shown. No file will move and no permission will change. The situation will be checked again before the correction.

kind.outsideProject: Path outside project or not normalized
kind.pathCollision: A file occupies a directory location
kind.projectIdentityMismatch: Directory identity could not be verified
kind.copyLocationMismatch: Git copy outside its expected location
kind.unregisteredDocument: File not registered in a deliverable

help.unregisteredDocument: Use the deliverable document import to preserve identity, versions and validation. Do not insert a database row manually.
help.copyMissing: Locate the copy and its local changes or restore a backup. A fresh remote clone cannot recover unpublished changes.
help.documentMissing: Locate the original document or restore a backup through document management. Creating an empty file would hide data loss.
help.scanLimited: Inspection is incomplete. Automatic corrections are disabled for this report.
help.directoryMissing: An empty directory can only be recreated when its identity and parent are verified and no registered content needs restoring.
help.agentReferenceObsolete: The migrated directory exists. The database reference can be realigned without moving data or changing permissions.
help.agentOverrideObsolete: The migrated directory exists. The remembered conversation directory can be realigned without changing its security policy.
help.activeFolderRegistrationMissing: The connection saved for this item no longer exists. Open the corrections to confirm using the project folder, or choose another reference in the relevant item’s explorer.
help.unregisteredCopy: Inspect files and unpublished Git changes before relinking or cleaning up. No repository is deleted automatically.

confirmProjectFolder: This reference will point to the project Folders directory shown below. No files will be moved, permissions broadened or running turns changed. To choose another folder, use the affected item’s explorer.
correctionsIntro: Choose an action for this issue. A correction only runs after confirmation.
noAutomaticRepair: No automatic correction is available for this issue. Follow the guidance above to locate or reconnect existing data.
openAgentReference: Open the agent to choose another reference
issueResolved: This issue is no longer present in the refreshed inspection.

visual.beforeConfirm: Preview of the expected result. No correction has been applied yet.

unknown.explanation: The inspection reported an issue. Review the details and available actions before making changes.
unknown.title: Issue to review

outsideProject.explanation: This path is outside the project boundaries. The inspection cannot access this location.
outsideProject.title: A path is outside the project

symbolicLink.explanation: This location redirects to another path. The inspection does not follow the link to stay within its allowed scope.
symbolicLink.title: A folder redirects to another location

pathCollision.explanation: A file occupies the location reserved for a folder. Check its contents before reorganizing this location.
pathCollision.title: A file occupies a folder’s location

projectRootMissing.explanation: Mergeron knows this project but cannot find its main folder at the expected location.
projectRootMissing.title: The main project folder was not found

projectLocationMismatch.explanation: The main path does not match the expected layout. Its origin needs checking before making changes.
projectLocationMismatch.title: The main folder is in an unexpected location

migrationRequired.explanation: This project uses an older folder layout. A dedicated migration is required to preserve its data.
migrationRequired.title: The project layout needs migrating

projectIdentityMismatch.explanation: The inspection cannot confirm that this folder belongs to this project. No change is proposed on that basis.
projectIdentityMismatch.title: The folder identity needs checking

directoryMissing.explanation: An expected folder was not found. Creating it empty is only offered when the server has verified that it is safe.
directoryMissing.title: A storage folder is missing

documentMissing.explanation: This document is registered but its file was not found or is not a valid file. It may have moved: look for the original or a backup.
documentMissing.title: A registered document was not found

currentVersionMissing.explanation: The current document version is not registered in its history. This does not establish that the file is missing.
currentVersionMissing.title: The current version is not registered

snapshotMissing.explanation: A version is registered in history but its file is unavailable at the expected location. Check backups.
snapshotMissing.title: A historical version file was not found

documentLocationMismatch.explanation: The document is outside its expected deliverable storage. Check the file and its association.
documentLocationMismatch.title: A document is outside its deliverable

snapshotLocationMismatch.explanation: This version file is outside its expected history storage. Check its location.
snapshotLocationMismatch.title: A version is outside history storage

copyRegistrationMissing.explanation: This Git copy is known but its location is not registered. Check the copy and its changes before linking it.
copyRegistrationMissing.title: A Git copy lost its registered location

copyLocationMismatch.explanation: This Git copy is located elsewhere than expected. Preserve its files and local changes during inspection.
copyLocationMismatch.title: A Git copy is in an unexpected location

copyMissing.explanation: Mergeron knows this Git copy but cannot find its folder. A fresh remote copy would not recover unpublished changes.
copyMissing.title: A registered Git copy was not found

gitMetadataMissing.explanation: The folder exists but its Git information is not present as expected. Check the files before recreating a copy.
gitMetadataMissing.title: This copy’s Git information is missing

agentReferenceObsolete.explanation: The migrated folder was found but the agent still stores an old reference. The inspection may offer to restore this link.
agentReferenceObsolete.title: An agent still uses an old reference

agentOverrideObsolete.explanation: This conversation stores an old path although the migrated folder exists. The reference can be aligned if the server offers it.
agentOverrideObsolete.title: A conversation still uses an old folder

agentReferenceMissing.explanation: The folder used as this agent’s reference was not found. Check its location or select another reference.
agentReferenceMissing.title: An agent’s reference folder was not found

unregisteredDocument.explanation: A file exists without a matching document in Mergeron. Document import preserves identity, versions and checks.
unregisteredDocument.title: A file is not registered in the deliverable

unregisteredDeliverableDirectory.explanation: A folder exists without a matching deliverable. It may be a technical folder: verify its origin before linking or cleaning up.
unregisteredDeliverableDirectory.title: A folder exists without an associated deliverable

unregisteredCopy.explanation: A Git copy exists without a registered association. It may contain unpublished changes: verify its origin and contents.
unregisteredCopy.title: A Git copy exists without being registered

scanLimited.explanation: The inspection limit was reached. Results are partial and automatic corrections are disabled for this report.
scanLimited.title: The inspection is incomplete

transferRunning.explanation: Folders are being transferred. Wait for completion and refresh the inspection before correcting a reference.
transferRunning.title: A transfer has paused corrections

primaryLocationMismatch.explanation: The primary location stored in the database does not match the expected project location. References need checking.
primaryLocationMismatch.title: The project’s primary connection is inconsistent

activeFolderRegistrationMissing.explanation: This item stores a connection that no longer exists. This does not mean its files were deleted. The inspection may offer Folders as a new reference.
activeFolderRegistrationMissing.title: An item lost its link to a folder

activeFolderOutsideWorkspace.explanation: The reference path is outside its connection boundaries. Select a reference in an allowed location.
activeFolderOutsideWorkspace.title: A reference is outside its allowed connection

activeFolderMissing.explanation: The connection is known but its reference folder was not found. Check the folder or select another reference.
activeFolderMissing.title: A reference folder was not found
